items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Scott Joplin music was, you, you had to be well acquainted with music to play that kind.

ctx.x: What about those, uh, rags, you know, like Scott Joplin and James Scott and Red Book stuff?

Well, that, that, that was, uh, that was, um, Scott Joplin music was, you, you had to be well acquainted with music to play that kind. Because, you see, you're running up on, uh, you're running up on, uh, thirty-second and sixty-fourth, eight notes, tired notes, and, uh, thirty-second and sixty-fourth notes, then you, you got to, you, you got to be well equipped with music, then, to play that Scott Joplin. Yeah, that Scott Joplin.
Yeah. What about the drummers, did they read, then, many of them?
